usage: Use **淺紅色** to mean a pale, light shade of red. 例句：我想要淺紅色嗰隻。
It can describe clothes, objects, or decorations. 例句：佢件衫係淺紅色。
You can use it when comparing colour shades in everyday talk. 例句：呢支唇膏顏色偏淺紅色。
It is a noun phrase, so it often comes after a colour or style description. 例句：我哋揀咗淺紅色牆身。
